info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Offering Management API
info.description: The Public Offering Management API enables users to initiate and manage public offerings within the corporate finance domain. This API allows companies to submit their offering proposals, providing essential details and documentation to facilitate market entry. Typical consumers include investment banks and corporate finance teams seeking to streamline the offering process. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance efficiency, ensure compliance, and promote transparency in their public offering activities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate the process of creating a public offering within the corporate finance sector. Users can provide details about the offering, including financial metrics and relevant documentation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new public offering under the corporate finance module. It should contain all necessary details required for processing the public offering, ensuring the data conforms to the defined schema.
